description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
